```{r}
exports <- getNamespaceExports("RiemannFinMath") |> sort()
chapter_files <- list.files("chapters", pattern = "^ch.*qmd$", full.names = TRUE)
uses <- map(chapter_files, \(f) {
  text <- readLines(f, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE) |> paste(collapse = "\n")
  found <- str_match_all(text, "RiemannFinMath::([a-z_0-9]+)")[[1]][, 2] |> unique()
  tibble(fn = found, chapter = str_extract(basename(f), "ch[0-9]+[a-z]?"))
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  summarise(Chapters = paste(sort(unique(chapter)), collapse = ", "), .by = fn)
coverage <- tibble(fn = exports) |>
  left_join(counterparts, by = "fn") |>
  left_join(uses, by = "fn") |>
  arrange(fn)
stopifnot(!anyNA(coverage$quantlib))
coverage |>
  transmute(Function = paste0("`", fn, "`"), `QuantLib side` = quantlib, Chapters = replace_na(Chapters, "not called")) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: coverage
#| echo: false
tibble(`Exported functions` = nrow(coverage), `Called in a chapter` = sum(!is.na(coverage$Chapters))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
